notes.title: v0.9.4 Mansion Court and Hair Physics
notes.content:
Heya!

It's time for a mid-sized update! With version 0.9.4, [b]The Mansion[/b] is now available as the first indoor court in Pixel Tennis. It is the most detailed court yet and should set a baseline for the games graphical capabilities. You can select it in multiplayer mode or play it in singleplayer, after you reached a certain level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986041/8f19dc4344772e276d1c4417c2a4316eb5533dfe.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986041/826e8a04118178ef447bbe173f93010f90c6de5c.jpg[/img]

If you played Pixel Tennis for some time, you might have noticed one of the random loading screen texts, which said "[i]Now with improved hair physics[/i]". This was intended to be some nonsense, when the [url=https://pixeltennis.com/viewtopic.php?t=96]player models were basic pills[/url]. Now, the game actually supports hair physics - because... why not?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986041/29abec42808601ef598fd54b8c9884a9a66fdb07.gif[/img]
[i]*wiggle wiggle*[/i]

Did you see this hair style? No? It is already available since the previous update. It is one of the special items, which has a secret unlock condition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986041/95d6868081c9f53b15c1c68ac4a888271f5ab18a.png[/img]

As there is - at the time of writing - only 1 player besides me, that unlocked it, I want to give a small hint:
- Everyone can obtain this item right away
- Everyone can see, that only 2 players (currently) fulfilled the unlock condition
Happy hunting!

Last, but not least a big THANKS to [b]Jan (S4ndf1re)[/b], who implemented a tennis rule, which was missing until now (and always bothered me for no real reason). Players now correctly change their court sides after every odd set!

As always, every feedback is welcome. If you find bugs or have a suggestion – don’t hesitate to let me know!

tags.feature: With version 0.9.4, [b]The Mansion[/b] is now available as the first indoor court in Pixel Tennis.
Now, the game actually supports hair physics - because... why not?

tags.bug: Players now correctly change their court sides after every odd set!

notes.title: v0.9.3
notes.content:
Another smaller update, but with an important bugfix for multiplayer matches:

[b]Character Design[/b]
Improved visuals of clothing with non solid textures

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Character now attempts to jump towards the ball more often, when it is out of reach

[b]UI[/b]
Replaced shopping bag with shopping cart icon for better distinction
Fixed character attribute bar was empty, if value was 50 (str, sta, dex, wil)

[b]Gameserver[/b]
Fixed server detecting serves as invalid in specific situations, which could crash the game after a few seconds (!)
Fixed "Username or password wrong" error when trying to link to a Steam account, which had no previous login
Improved responsibility when player starts charging a hit
(Hopefully) fixed an issue, where running animation did not play and character slid over the ground

notes.title: v0.9.2
notes.content:
Minor fixes and QoL changes:

[b]UI[/b]
Automatically hide mouse cursor while in match
Potentially fixed a problem, where the main menu could disappear on back/esc press
Switch between chat types with TAB instead of CTRL to prevent accidental switching (e.g. when using keyboard shortcuts)
Updated French translation by faller-magie
Made top icons during match clickable while match menu is opened, so that they can be access with the gamepad controlled virtual mouse cursor
Allow opening match chat with the select button
Updated some more old references from pixeltennis.de to pixeltennis.com domain
Added link to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2377430/discussions/]Steam Communityhub[/url] in the news for gathering player feedback
When the loading screen randomly would show the text "Your princess is on another court" and the current user is named *Princess*, the text is replaced with "The Princess is on this court!" [url="https://discord.com/channels/315582630534053888/694239079797227561/1232767454883872819"]reference[/url]

[b]Misc[/b]
Improved detection of gamepad types
Prevent initializing the VirtualGamepad in builds when on-screen controls are not used
